title: showParentLevel not working when preceded by breadcrumb widget
body:
Hello,

When a hierarchicalMenu widget and a breadcrumb widget are used, using the same attributes, then the showParentLevel false doesn't work, stays default true.

If you remove the breadcrumb widget, the showParentLevel false works again.

Expected to also hide the parents when the option is set to false

comments.body: Did you add the parameter to both?
Yes, Even though the option is not declared for the breadcrumb, but no difference

I've just tried it out, and it seems to work the same with or without the breadcrumb. Can you try this out and describe what's not expected for you? 

https://codesandbox.io/s/6nl0l36n83

Aha, found the issue then, the position of the widget seems to be it. When you first add the breadcrumb, and then the menu, it doesn't work:
https://codesandbox.io/s/w6x88pv3w5
Aha, that's right, sounds like a bug. Thanks for reporting it!
